title: Med-CMR: A Fine-Grained Benchmark Integrating Visual Evidence and Clinical Logic for Medical Complex Reasoning
source: /Users/xxxiaoling/Downloads/Gong et al. - Med-CMR A Fine-Grained Benchmark Integrating Visual Evidence and Clinical Logic for Medical Complex.pdf
method: 20,653-question multimodal medical complex-reasoning benchmark with MCQ and open-ended tracks across seven dimensions
evidence: Open-ended rubric emphasizes visual accuracy and ground-truth match
Reported errors concentrate in fine-grained recognition, evidence integration, and medical long-tail knowledge
limitations: Public GitHub repository currently does not expose a complete data and evaluator package
LLM-based open-ended judging requires independent reliability checks
Paper-reported model scores are not automatically comparable with future local runs
transfer_decision: Use as target benchmark and dimension taxonomy; gate all execution on data/evaluator availability and separate paper-reported from reproduced scores.
